testCases.title: Reject logged-out Traveler Bearer token on GET /api/customer-requests after POST /api/traveler/logout
testCases.urlConfirmedSource: Observed in accommodation request module chunk 452btq2-mvhin.js on https://web.stag.goodnstay.com
testCases.errorContractSource: Confirmed directly from same-session logout baseline on GET /api/traveler/me and PUT /api/customer-requests/:id -> HTTP 401 ('You are not logged in.') immediately after POST /api/traveler/logout
testCases.owaspMapping: OWASP A07:2025 Authentication Failures (CWE-613) & A01:2025 · OWASP API2:2023
testCases.requirement: Session Lifecycle Parity & API Standard (Confluence 524593) — Once POST /api/traveler/logout succeeds (HTTP 200), the invalidated Bearer token must fail closed (HTTP 401) across all protected Customer Request endpoints.
testCases.priorityAndLayer: P0 / API Permission & Session Lifecycle Parity
testCases.environment: STAGING · Date: 2026-11-19 · Deployed SHA: fe_web=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt (chunks: 452btq2-mvhin, 0lu641k7h1gc_, 0v23-8ja2iskk, 44apr7-70_4vc), be_api=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA — ask Strapi/Gateway/Notification Backend & DevOps Owner>
testCases.preconditions: Create an isolated QA Traveler login session via POST /api/traveler/login and invalidate it via POST /api/traveler/logout (HTTP 200 OK; confirmed GET /api/traveler/me -> HTTP 401).
testCases.headersAuthParams: Accept: application/json; Origin: https://web.stag.goodnstay.com; Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_LOGGED_OUT_QA_TOKEN>
testCases.payloadAndTestData: None (GET request without body). Single-Variable Delta: replace active Authorization token with isolated Bearer token already logged out via POST /api/traveler/logout.
testCases.singleChangeDelta: Replace active Bearer token with Bearer token invalidated via POST /api/traveler/logout
steps: 1. Authenticate an isolated QA Traveler session via POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/login.
2. Invalidate that session via POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/logout (returns HTTP 200 OK) and confirm GET /api/traveler/me returns HTTP 401.
3. Send GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/customer-requests using the logged-out Bearer token.
4. Verify HTTP status and check whether protected Customer Request records are returned.
testCases.expectedResponse: HTTP 401 Unauthorized ('You are not logged in.'), matching GET /api/traveler/me and PUT /api/customer-requests/:id.
testCases.expectedDataResult: Zero Customer Request records returned to a logged-out Bearer token.
testCases.actualResult: FAIL — GET /api/customer-requests accepted the logged-out Bearer token with HTTP 200 OK and returned all 31 Customer Request records (checkInDate, checkOutDate, stayingCity, notes, hotelBids).

resultRecord.dataCheck: FAIL: Returned 31 Customer Request records to logged-out Bearer token

testCases.title: Handle disallowed Origin header on GET /api/v1/notifications without throwing unhandled HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

testCases.owaspMapping: OWASP A10:2025 Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions (CWE-755, CWE-209) & A02:2025 · OWASP API8:2023
testCases.requirement: OpenAPI Governance (Confluence 144015744 — 4xx vs 5xx Separation) & Same-Host CORS Parity (/api/traveler/me omits ACAO cleanly without 500) — Untrusted Origin header must never trigger unhandled HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.
testCases.priorityAndLayer: P1 / API Error Contract & CORS Configuration
testCases.environment: STAGING · Date: 2026-11-19 · Deployed SHA: fe_web=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt (chunks: 452btq2-mvhin, 0lu641k7h1gc_, 0v23-8ja2iskk, 44apr7-70_4vc), be_api=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA — ask Strapi/Gateway/Notification Backend & DevOps Owner>

testCases.payloadAndTestData: None (GET request without body). Single-Variable Delta: mutate ONLY Origin header from 'https://web.stag.goodnstay.com' to 'https://untrusted-origin.example.test'.
testCases.singleChangeDelta: Mutate ONLY Origin request header from 'https://web.stag.goodnstay.com' to 'https://untrusted-origin.example.test'
steps: 1. Confirm baseline GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/v1/notifications?limit=5 with Origin: https://web.stag.goodnstay.com returns HTTP 200 OK.
2. Change ONLY the Origin header to https://untrusted-origin.example.test and send GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/v1/notifications?limit=5.
3. Inspect HTTP status code, CORS headers, and error body.
4. Confirm notification records remain unchanged via baseline GET readback.
testCases.expectedResponse: Clean CORS rejection omitting Access-Control-Allow-Origin (matching /api/traveler/me) or controlled 403 error (<CHECK_OPENAPI> / <CHECK_ERROR_REGISTRY>) — never HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.
testCases.expectedDataResult: No notification records created or modified.
testCases.actualResult: FAIL — Server threw unhandled HTTP 500 Internal Server Error: {"error": {"code": "INTERNAL_ERROR", "messageKey": "errors.internal", "details": {"name": "Error", "message": "Origin https://untrusted-origin.example.test is not allowed by CORS"}}}.

resultRecord.dataCheck: Notification records unchanged; CORS callback threw unhandled HTTP 500
